source: DATA_MODEL §3 (core.score_reasons.code, core.reason_templates, core.red_flag_rules, score_models.config factor weights 30/30/20/15/5); API_CONTRACTS §2.1 reason texts.
notes: Templates are filled by the scoring pipeline (T11) and stored as finished text in core.score_reasons.text. An LLM never adds facts to a reason.
{param} placeholders take the already-formatted value. A test renders the four Aurelia reasons from these templates and compares them with API_CONTRACTS §2.1.
status draft means the methodology owner still has to approve the wording before it is published.

reasons.template_en: {time_used_pct}% of the promised time used. QPRs filed late in {late_count} of the last {window_count} quarters.
{count_24m} complaints decided against the promoter in 24 months · {per_100_units} per 100 units. Median count for similar projects: {median_count}.
{late_count} of the group's {finished_count} finished RERA projects got OC more than 12 months late.

pending_codes.description: A QPR that was due is not on the authority's portal. Marker line names the date the band may change.
pending_codes.example_line: The Jul–Sep 2026 QPR is not on HARERA yet. It was due 15 Oct 2026.

pending_codes.description: A new filing is in and the re-score is due within 72 hours. No figures from the new filing are shown until then.
pending_codes.example_line: The Jul–Sep 2026 QPR was filed 15 Oct and fetched 16 Oct, 7:40 pm. We update this by 19 Oct 2026, 7:40 pm.
